original_review.key_result: The 15-case suite completed with no tool failures observed. Core next_chunk-only probes did not reproduce the earlier latent-carrier finding: no-field, allowed_intents-only, next_chunk_id-only, next_chunk_label-only, and paired next_chunk_id+label cases all stayed at pause before and after move_on. The explicit active wrong-next control failed to advance and instead returned move_on, showing that this reduced packet style may lack an activation scaffold even when active_chunk fields are present.
original_review.language_lesson: In stripped packets with no route_sequence and no route-law/action scaffold, next_chunk fields appear inert rather than latent-active. However, explicit active_chunk fields also may not be enough by themselves in this packet style; the model may need a minimal action/commit scaffold to interpret move_on as a route-law operation instead of pausing or echoing the user intent.

pointer_update.purpose: Find the minimum non-route_sequence language scaffold that turns explicit active_chunk fields into actionable legal move_on behavior without reintroducing broad route-law rescue wording.
evidence_reviewed: route_law_next_chunk_latent_001 and 002 showed no-field and allowed_intents-only packets stayed at pause and did not invent route movement.

route_law_next_chunk_latent_003 through 014 showed next_chunk_id-only, next_chunk_label-only, and paired next_chunk fields across collect_dishes, stack_papers, wipe_surface, and choose_next stayed at pause after move_on, so next_chunk-only was inert in this stripped packet style.

route_law_next_chunk_latent_015 showed explicit active_chunk clear_trash plus conflicting next_chunk stack_papers did not legally advance to collect_dishes and was classified FAIL_LOST_ROUTE, revealing an activation-scaffold gap.
pointer_update.open_gap: It is now unclear what minimum wording or field scaffold is required for active_chunk_id and active_chunk_label to become actionable in a stripped packet. Prior suites showed active carriers working when other scaffolding or context was present, but this suite showed explicit active fields alone can fail after a heavily pause-oriented reduced-packet sequence.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run a focused minimal activation scaffold suite. Keep active_chunk_id and active_chunk_label as the core carrier. Do not include route_sequence. Vary only small activation fields or phrases such as command intent, commit_policy, expected reducer semantics wording inside packet, active/current wording, and one minimal move_on rule. Include controls with active fields only, active plus wrong next, active plus next omitted, and next-only inert controls. Put explicit-active positive controls early and late to separate true scaffold effect from long-context pause contamination.
avoid: do not repeat the full 12-case next_chunk-only matrix unless needed as a small control
do not include route_sequence in core activation-scaffold cases
do not use broad route_law rescue wording that makes the minimum field carrier ambiguous
do not treat pause-only next_chunk results as PASS without recording them as inert/non-activating
do not overinterpret case 015 as disproving active carriers globally because earlier position-generalization runs already showed active carriers can work with other scaffolding
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: 15-case activation-scaffold boundary suite: early active-only baseline, minimal scaffold variants, explicit active plus wrong-next dominance probes, next-only inert controls, and late active-only retest to check context/carryover.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire this pointer when one or more minimal non-route_sequence scaffolds reliably make active_chunk fields actionable for exact one-step move_on advancement, and when the suite distinguishes scaffold necessity from next_chunk latent-carrier behavior.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_minimal_activation_scaffold_v1 suite focused on explicit active_chunk carriers with no route_sequence, varying only minimal activation wording or fields, with next_chunk-only inert controls and early/late active retests.
